speaker: Patient
text: No, I don't have any shortness of breath, fever, or chest pain, and I haven't coughed up anything colored. I don't smoke, and while I work as a teacher, I don't think I've had any recent exposure to strong chemicals. However, I do get occasional heartburn and sometimes feel like I have a runny nose that drips down my throat at night. However, my cardiologist of 10 years has already confirmed hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This visit is only for second recording — please do not re-diagnose.
